title: Shared definitions for risk-reporting skill schemas
description: Shared $defs that per-skill schemas in this plugin commonly redefine. Per-skill schemas should $ref these via "../_defs.json#/$defs/<name>" rather than redefining the same enums and shapes inline. Plugin-specific extras (rag_status_enum, materiality_classification_enum) sit alongside the base definitions; they show up across kri-commentary, risk-committee-pack, management-response, attestation-pack, cyber-disclosure-readiness.

severity_enum.description: Standard four-step severity ladder for risks called out in board and committee packs.

severity_enum_with_moderate.description: Variant ladder used by audit findings and exam-letter ingestion where 'moderate' has settled meaning.

confidence_label.description: Author confidence in the artifact as a whole. For aggregated reports (committee packs, attestation packs) the label reflects the worst sub-component plus the depth of cross-checks.

owner_role.description: Named firm function or role with accountability (e.g., 'CRO', 'Chief Compliance Officer', 'Head of Risk Reporting', 'CFO', 'CISO', 'Disclosure Committee Chair'). Never an individual person.

human_review_gate.description: Embedded human-review-gate descriptor. Common risk-reporting gates: CRO attestation, disclosure-committee materiality determination, board risk-committee adoption, Item 1.05 / Item 106 sign-off.

rag_status_enum.description: Traffic-light status used in KRI commentary and committee packs. 'breach' is reserved for KRIs that have crossed a board-set tolerance and triggers a defined escalation path; 'not-rated' is used for newly added metrics before tolerance is set.

materiality_classification_enum.description: Materiality determination for SEC cyber disclosures and similar disclosure-readiness artifacts. The determination is owned by the disclosure committee; the skill captures the working classification but does not set it finally.
